tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: List official QuokkaPix local/browser image workflow recipes. Use this first when an agent needs a supported workflow for Shopify, Amazon, Google Merchant, WebP compression, metadata cleanup, social packs, watermarking, favicon generation or similar repeatable image tasks. Returns ids that can be passed to get_recipe or process_images.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Return one official QuokkaPix recipe by id. Use this before process_images when the agent needs exact applySettings, max file limits, payment expectations and expected result QA checks. This tool does not process images.

id.description: Recipe id from list_recipes, for example shopify_product_pack, amazon_product_batch or metadata_clean_batch.

tools.name: validate_recipe
tools.description: Validate a custom QuokkaPix recipe before using process_images. Use this when an agent generated its own recipe JSON and needs to confirm that id, applySettings.mode, applySettings.tool, optional structured steps and requires.maxFiles are valid. This is a preflight check only and does not open a browser or process files.

id.description: Stable recipe id, for example shopify_product_pack.

description.description: Short explanation of what the recipe prepares.

mode.description: Use single for one image or batch for multiple images.

tool.description: QuokkaPix editor tool id, such as resize, crop, rotate, convert, compress, metadata, background, watermark, effects, rename, pdf, favicon or constructor.

steps.description: Optional ordered scenario steps. Prefer [{ tool, settings }] for custom multi-step workflows.

anyOf.description: Simple QuokkaPix tool id step, for example resize, background, compress or watermark.

tool.description: QuokkaPix tool id for this scenario step, for example resize, background, compress or watermark.

settings.description: Settings for this step using the same keys accepted by window.QuokkaPixAgent.applySettings.

anyOf.description: Structured scenario step with a tool id and per-step settings.

items.description: One step in a QuokkaPix scenario workflow.

applySettings.description: QuokkaPix settings applied before processing starts.

requires.description: Recipe requirements such as maxFiles and payment policy.

maxFiles.description: Maximum files allowed by this recipe.

payment.description: Whether the recipe normally needs a paid batch/scenario unlock.

output.description: Expected output type, for example zip, image, pdf or json.

qa.description: Machine-readable QA checks for the result manifest.

expectedOutputKind.description: Expected high-level output kind for QA checks.

expectedFormat.description: Required output format, for example webp, jpg, png, pdf or zip.

allowedFormats.description: Allowed output formats for every manifest output entry.

expectedMinOutputs.description: Minimum number of output entries expected.

expectedWidth.description: Exact expected output width in pixels.

expectedHeight.description: Exact expected output height in pixels.

maxWidth.description: Maximum allowed output width in pixels.

maxHeight.description: Maximum allowed output height in pixels.

minWidth.description: Minimum recommended output width in pixels.

minHeight.description: Minimum recommended output height in pixels.

requireSquare.description: Require square output dimensions when true.

maxOutputKB.description: Recommended maximum output size per non-archive file.

marketplace.description: Marketplace profile name used for human-readable QA context.

visualChecks.description: Visual checks requested by a recipe. Current validator reports these as metadata-only limitations.

recipe.description: Custom QuokkaPix recipe object. Use validate_recipe before process_images when generating this dynamically.

tools.name: list_rule_profiles
tools.description: List sourced image requirement profiles for marketplaces and social placements. Use this before marketplace QA when an agent needs facts for Amazon, Shopify, Google Merchant, Etsy, eBay, Walmart, TikTok Shop, Mercado Libre, Temu, Shopee, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Pinterest, Facebook or TikTok. Secondary sources are marked explicitly.

tools.name: get_rule_profile
tools.description: Return one sourced platform image rule profile by id, including requirements, recommendations, source URL, source type and confidence. This tool does not process files and does not invent missing marketplace rules.

id.description: Rule profile id from list_rule_profiles, for example amazon.product.image or instagram.feed.photo.

tools.name: validate_result_manifest
tools.description: Validate an existing quokkapix-result.json manifest against an official recipe or custom QA contract. Use this after process_images/process_with_settings or when inspecting a previous run. It checks status, file counts, formats, dimensions, size limits, ZIP entry metadata and marketplace QA metadata; it does not read image pixels or upload files.

tools.name: process_images
tools.description: Process local image files through the QuokkaPix browser app using an official recipeId or a full custom recipe. Source files stay local. Without unlockToken, the browser returns an exact quote after ZIP expansion/PDF inspection and before paid processing. Retry the unchanged call with the quoted product token.

tools.name: process_with_settings
tools.description: Process local image files with a direct window.QuokkaPixAgent.applySettings payload instead of an official recipe. Use this for custom resize/crop/convert/compress/background/watermark/effects/rename/PDF/favicon/scenario workflows. For multi-step scenarios, prefer settings.steps as [{ tool, settings }]. The adapter downloads the output, writes quokkapix-result.json and returns QA results.

tools.description: Return one official Video recipe, its browser settings and expected-result QA.

tools.name: validate_video_recipe
tools.description: Validate a custom Video recipe without opening a browser or processing media.

recipe.description: QuokkaPix Video recipe with settings and optional expected-result QA.

tools.description: List official-source profiles for YouTube, TikTok Ads and Meta Reels video workflows.

tools.description: Open Video in local Chromium and keep media local. Without unlockToken, return an exact duration/transcription quote before paid work; retry the same call with the product-specific token.

recipeId.description: Official id from list_video_recipes. Provide recipeId or recipe.

recipe.description: QuokkaPix Video recipe with settings and optional expected-result QA.

inputFile.description: One local video path uploaded through the browser file input.

musicFile.description: Optional local audio/media path for mix or replace-audio recipes.

outputDir.description: Local directory where the adapter writes the downloaded output and quokkapix-result.json.

appUrl.description: Optional Video app URL. Defaults to https://video.quokkapix.com/#agent=1.

unlockToken.description: Product-specific x402 unlock token. Omit it to receive a local duration-based quote before processing.

tools.description: Run one local video through window.QuokkaPixVideoAgent.applySettings-compatible settings, save the media or transcript output and write quokkapix-video-result.json.

musicFile.description: Absolute or client-relative local file path readable by the MCP process. Do not pass remote URLs here.

tools.name: get_payment_options
tools.description: Fetch live QuokkaPix Image and Video payment tiers, free limits and product-specific x402 endpoints. This tool does not sign, submit or consume a payment.

baseUrl.description: Optional QuokkaPix site base URL. Defaults to https://quokkapix.com.

tools.name: explain_payment_flow
tools.description: Explain the unified Image/PDF/Video x402 workflow: inspect locally, quote exactly, pay the product endpoint, optionally verify, then retry unchanged with unlockToken. This adapter can use a token but cannot sign x402 payments itself.

baseUrl.description: Optional QuokkaPix site base URL. Defaults to https://quokkapix.com.

tools.name: verify_unlock_token
tools.description: Safely preflight a QuokkaPix paid agent unlock token without consuming it. The browser consumes the one-time unlock only when the paid batch actually starts. If scope, price or currency are omitted, the tool reads live payment options first.

token.description: Unlock token returned by the paid x402 unlock endpoint.

baseUrl.description: Optional QuokkaPix site base URL. Defaults to https://quokkapix.com.

scope.description: Expected QuokkaPix scope. Defaults to live payment options.

price.description: Expected price string. Defaults to live payment options.

currency.description: Expected currency. Defaults to live payment options.

mode.description: Run mode to verify against the unlock token.

files.description: Number of files intended for the paid run.
